place.name: Chorrillos District
place.description: Chorrillos (Spanish: [t͡ʃoriˈʎos]; lit. 'trickles [of water]') is a district of Lima, Peru. A middle-income residential district, it is located next to the Pacific Ocean and forms part of the city's area known as the Costa Verde, which is home to a number of beaches, as well as private clubs and the country's national military school.
